# VYRON: The Living Map of Technology

> VYRON is an open-source, provenance-first interactive technology atlas, live GitHub repository analyzer, PyPI/npm package dependency & release history explorer, and side-by-side comparison tool. Every fact carries an explicit provenance label and exact upstream source URLs.

## Important Status Notice

VYRON is in early development and is **not production ready**. Its interactive map currently displays a clearly labelled 60-entity development seed graph (`provenance: "seed"`), while its Repository, Dependencies, Release History, and Compare pages read live public data from GitHub, PyPI, and npm on demand (`provenance: "sourced"`) without storing user or registry data in a database or in browser storage.

## When to Use VYRON

Reach for VYRON when a developer, researcher, or AI agent needs deterministic, provenance-labelled software ecosystem evidence without subjective scores or vendor lock-in:

- **Inspect a public GitHub repository live:** Fetch verified stars, forks, open issues & pull requests, SPDX license, byte-share language breakdown, opt-in top contributors & latest release, and 52-week commit activity with exact GitHub REST API `source_urls` and cache freshness (`Live` / `Confirmed` / `Stale`).
  - Browser URL: `https://vyronmap.vercel.app/repository.html?repo=pallets/flask`
  - API call: `curl -sS https://vyronmap.vercel.app/api/v1/github/repositories/pallets/flask`
- **Trace PyPI or npm package dependencies and release timelines live:** Read declared unconditional dependencies one package at a time (separating left-out conditional, dev, peer, and optional dependencies) and inspect exact registry release dates (`first_file_upload` for PyPI, `publish_time` for npm).
  - Browser URL: `https://vyronmap.vercel.app/dependencies.html?package=pypi:flask`
  - API calls:
    - `curl -sS "https://vyronmap.vercel.app/api/v1/registries/pypi/package?name=flask"`
    - `curl -sS "https://vyronmap.vercel.app/api/v1/registries/pypi/releases?name=flask"`
- **Compare two packages or two public GitHub repositories side by side:** Generate a deterministic diff of Shared vs. Only-A vs. Only-B direct dependencies, release spans, or language byte shares with downloadable JSON evidence packs.
  - Browser URL: `https://vyronmap.vercel.app/compare.html?mode=packages&a=pypi:flask&b=pypi:django`
- **Explore technology relationships, clusters, shortest paths, and timelines:** Query the 60-entity development-seed technology atlas for cluster membership, PageRank centrality estimates, shortest undirected paths, and historical slices.
  - Browser URL: `https://vyronmap.vercel.app/?q=python`
  - API call: `curl -sS "https://vyronmap.vercel.app/api/v1/search?q=python"`
- **Read token-light Markdown directly from any page:** Send `Accept: text/markdown` to any HTML route (`/`, `/repository.html`, `/dependencies.html`, `/compare.html`, `/about`, `/contact`, `/privacy`) to receive structured Markdown with `Vary: Accept`.
  - Example: `curl -sS -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://vyronmap.vercel.app/`

### When NOT to Use VYRON

- Do not use VYRON for private GitHub repositories, authenticated user accounts, or persistent database-backed historical analytics (none of those are built yet).
- Do not treat the 60-entity seed map as an exhaustive production catalog; always check each response's `provenance` field and `data_notice`.

## Primary Pages

- [VYRON Interactive Technology Map](https://vyronmap.vercel.app/): 60 seed entities, 68 relationships, 20 auto-detected clusters, fuzzy search, accessible text outline, shortest-path tracer, historical year slider with Play/Pause playback, and JSON entity export.
- [Live GitHub Repository Analysis](https://vyronmap.vercel.app/repository.html): Live public GitHub REST API reader with stars, forks, license, language shares, cache freshness, opt-in contributors/latest release, opt-in 52-week commit activity, and JSON export.
- [PyPI & npm Package Dependency Graph + Release History](https://vyronmap.vercel.app/dependencies.html): On-demand layered dependency graph for PyPI and npm packages with left-out conditional/dev/peer/optional declarations, opt-in release history timeline & table, and JSON evidence packs.
- [Side-by-Side Compare](https://vyronmap.vercel.app/compare.html): Deterministic side-by-side comparison of two PyPI/npm packages or two public GitHub repositories with overlap diffs and provenance badges.

## Trust & Information Pages

- [About VYRON](https://vyronmap.vercel.app/about): Mission, provenance model, early-development status, open-source MIT license, and source repository.
- [Contact VYRON](https://vyronmap.vercel.app/contact): Maintainer contact, GitHub issue tracker, security vulnerability reporting, and community standards.
- [Privacy & Data Handling](https://vyronmap.vercel.app/privacy): Zero browser storage, zero tracking cookies, server-side-only upstream reads, and strict Content Security Policy.

## Core API Endpoints (Same-Origin JSON, OpenAPI 3.1)

- `GET /api/v1/meta` — Service metadata, enums, rate limits, and data mode (`seed` or `database`).
- `GET /api/v1/graph/overview` — Graph statistics, PageRank centrality estimates, and detected clusters.
- `GET /api/v1/graph/path?from=<uuid>&to=<uuid>` — Shortest undirected path between two entities.
- `GET /api/v1/search?q=<query>` — Ranked fuzzy search across entities.
- `GET /api/v1/timeline` — Dated timeline events across entities.
- `GET /api/v1/github/parse?input=<url-or-slug>` — Parse and normalize GitHub URLs or `owner/repo` strings.
- `GET /api/v1/github/repositories/{owner}/{repo}` — Live public GitHub repository analysis.
- `GET /api/v1/github/repositories/{owner}/{repo}/activity` — Opt-in top contributors and latest release.
- `GET /api/v1/github/repositories/{owner}/{repo}/commit-activity` — Opt-in 52-week weekly commit counts.
- `GET /api/v1/registries/{registry}/package?name=<pkg>` — Live PyPI or npm declared dependencies.
- `GET /api/v1/registries/{registry}/releases?name=<pkg>` — Live PyPI or npm release history dates.
- `GET /health/live` — Liveness probe.

## Direct Answers (AEO / GEO Reference)

### What makes VYRON different from ordinary technology directories?
Every fact carries an explicit provenance label (`sourced`, `estimated`, `inferred`, `predicted`, `user_generated`, `ai_generated`, or `seed`). Seed data is always flagged with a `data_notice`, and live GitHub/PyPI/npm readings carry exact `source_url`s, `fetched_at` timestamps, and cache freshness badges without adding subjective quality scores.

### Does VYRON store user tracking data or API keys in the browser?
No. VYRON enforces a strict Content Security Policy (`default-src 'self'`, no inline executable scripts or styles), uses zero `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, or tracking cookies, and keeps all upstream API calls server-side.

### What is built versus still planned?
Built and verified with automated tests: the domain model, provenance rules, in-memory graph engine, 21 of 34 HTTP API routes, generated OpenAPI 3.1 contract, typed TypeScript client, design token pipeline, and 4-page browser prototype. Still planned (not built): Next.js frontend, WebGL map renderer at scale, PostgreSQL/Neo4j/Redis persistence adapters, background ingestion workers, authentication, and the Gemini AI research adapter.
